capabilities: Previews flomo MEMO links as cards in Reading view and Live Preview
Reads memo content via the flomo MCP memo_batch_get tool
Keeps the original Markdown link unchanged
Caches memo text and tags for offline viewing
Stores the flomo token in Obsidian Secret Storage
extras: Interface is Chinese-only; cached memo text and tags are stored in plaintext in the plugin data.json and may be included in vault backups or sync; cards render body Markdown as plain text and do not show attachments; OAuth is not implemented.
problem: Flomo MEMO links pasted into notes appear as bare links, so reading a private memo requires leaving Obsidian and opening flomo.

relations.evidence: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later and flomo PRO or MAX for the official MCP service.

summary: Flomo link previewer that renders private MEMO links as cards in Reading view and Live Preview without changing the note's Markdown.
